name: Carolina Clock 'Stravaganza 2017
information: **Clock is the main event of this competition**, the winners of clock will be announced as the winners of the competition. There is no cutoff for clock, so everyone that would like to compete in clock may do so without any pressure. If you are thinking about registering, but feel the cutoffs are too strict, go ahead and register, and let the organization team know; we may be more lenient and adjust the cutoffs depending on the turnout. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue.
